name: The Time‑Woven Desert Garden
description: A desert oasis where vines of living clocks entwine, each leaf showing a different hour, and sundials bloom into flowers that track the passage of time.
prompt: A mesmerizing Time‑Woven Desert Garden: desert oasis surrounded by vines made of interlocking clocks, each leaf displaying a glowing hour, sundial flowers blooming and rotating with the sun, golden sand, soft warm lighting, ultra‑realistic, surreal desert.
caption: Tend the Time‑Woven Desert Garden and watch hours blossom into petals⏳🌸.
